description: Search public clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, treatment or sponsor, optionally narrowed by place (city, state, country, or a ZIP code with a radius), status, phase, sex or age. Use this first when a person wants to find trials; use get_clinical_trial when you already have an NCT ID. Each result has public registry fields and a clareohealth.com link. Results are paged: when hasMore is true, call again with page set to nextPage. Send conditions and places only, never a person's name, diagnosis history, medications or other health details. Not medical advice.

city.description: City, for example "Boston". Combine with state or country to narrow it.

minAge.description: Whole years. With maxAge, keeps trials whose eligible ages overlap minAge to maxAge. Use the same number for both to match one age.

query.description: Condition, treatment or sponsor, for example "breast cancer" or "type 1 diabetes". A place in the text ("asthma in Boston") also works; city, state and country are clearer.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles around zip, or around city with state. Defaults to 50 with a zip. Giving it with city and state searches around that US city instead of matching its name.

recruitingOnly.description: Only trials that are recruiting or enrolling by invitation. Ignored when status is set.

sex.description: Keep trials open to this sex. "all" applies no filter.

sortBy.description: relevance is the registry's order with condition matches first. distance (needs zip, or city with state and radiusMiles) puts the nearest site first among the best 50 matches.

status.description: Registry statuses to keep, for example ["RECRUITING","NOT_YET_RECRUITING"].

zip.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code, to find trials with a site within radiusMiles of it. Use it only when the person chooses to give a ZIP for this search. It is turned into coordinates on our server and not stored.

name: search_clinical_trials

appliedFilters.description: The filters the search used, so you can tell a person what was applied.

nextPage.description: Pass as page to get the next results, null on the last page.

distanceMiles.description: Miles to the nearest site, only when a zip or radius was searched.

lastUpdatePostDate.description: Date the registry last updated the record (YYYY-MM-DD).

locations.description: At most the first 10 sites. Use the trial page for all of them.

maxAge.description: Maximum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

minAge.description: Minimum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

phase.description: Registry phases joined with a slash, for example PHASE2/PHASE3.

searchUrl.description: The same search on clareohealth.com, for a person to open.

total.description: How many trials match in the registry.

title: Search clinical trials
